about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!
Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes:

  • Hybrid blaster “Alpha-N” R15-17
  • Active module “Universal repair module” R13-17
  • Capacitor modifier “Adaptation mechanism” R15-17
  • CPU modifier “Plasma summator” R15-17
  • 500 xenocrystals
  • 60 monocrystals
  • A set of resources for 50 ores: (Vanadium + Silicon + Graphite + Osmium) + 50 Crystal shards.
  • A set of colours: “Scarlet”, “Prosperity”, “Terracotta”
  • Unique portrait “Rahil “Coin” Weintraub”
  • Colouring preset “Predatory colour”

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 15 days!
